name: Full Season Holiday Service
metaTitle: Full Season Christmas Light Service | Ontario Homes
metaDescription: Design, install, maintenance, takedown and storage in one package. London Ontario and GTA homeowners call (519) 266-6796 for a free full-season quote.
heroIntro: Design, installation, mid-season maintenance, January takedown and optional storage, all handled by one crew from start to finish.
intro: Full Season Holiday Service is our all-inclusive program and the one most of our customers choose. Instead of booking lighting, then separately arranging takedown, then figuring out where to store everything, one booking covers the entire year. We design your display, supply commercial-grade LED lighting in the colours you want, install it custom-cut to your roofline in as little as one day, and fix anything that goes wrong at no extra charge while it is up.

When the season ends, we come back and take everything down, and you can add optional storage from $100 per season so the strands never sit in your garage between Novembers. It is the reason 96% of our customers rebook with us the following year, once the lights are installed the first time, there is nothing left for you to manage. Booking opens in late summer and fills by mid-November, so this program works best when reserved early.
included: Free custom design consultation and quote
Commercial-grade LED lighting supplied for your roofline, trees and shrubs
Mid-season maintenance, any bulb or strand issue fixed free
Optional year-round storage from $100 per season
One point of contact for the entire program

sections.heading: How the full-season program works
sections.text: You start with a free design consultation, either in person or from photos of your home, where we plan the roofline, tree, and shrub lighting you want. Once approved, we schedule your install for sometime between early October and the first week of December, custom-cutting every strand to your home rather than using generic pre-made lengths. Throughout the season, if anything stops working, a call gets it fixed free of charge. In January, the same program brings a crew back to take everything down and, if you have added storage, pack it away until next year.

sections.heading: What drives the price
sections.text: Because this program bundles design, lighting, installation, maintenance and takedown into one quote, pricing depends on the same factors as a standalone installation, roofline length, the height and pitch of your roof, whether trees or shrubs are included, and how many colours or light types you want. Adding year-round storage is a smaller add-on cost on top of the base package. We give you one all-in number up front so you know the full-season cost before committing, rather than separate bills for each stage.

sections.heading: What to expect across the season
sections.text: After installation, you can leave the display unlit until you are ready, since many homes are installed in October or November and switched on whenever the customer chooses. If a strand goes dark or a connector loosens during a cold snap, our maintenance visit resolves it without you needing to climb a ladder in the middle of winter. Once the holidays wrap up, takedown is scheduled for January through early February depending on weather and safe roof access, and we confirm the date with you ahead of time.

pricing: Full Season Holiday Service pricing follows the same tiers as our standalone lighting packages, Classic from $700, Festive from $1,400, and Griswold from $2,800, since design, installation, maintenance and takedown are bundled into the same quote. Most residential jobs total between $700 and $3,500. Adding year-round storage costs from $100 per season on top of your package.

faq.q: What exactly is included in Full Season Holiday Service?
faq.a: Design, commercial-grade LED lights supplied and installed, mid-season maintenance for any bulb or strand issue, and takedown in January are all included in one booking with one point of contact. Year-round storage is an optional add-on if you would rather not store the strands yourself between seasons, and we confirm the full scope before any work starts.

faq.q: Is this more expensive than booking installation and takedown separately?
faq.a: No, it is the same underlying service bundled into one quote instead of two or three separate bookings across the season. Pricing still depends on roofline length, height, and how much of the property is lit, following the same $700 to $3,500 range as a standalone installation, just without the extra coordination on your end.

faq.q: How early should I book the full-season program?
faq.a: Booking opens in late summer and our schedule fills by mid-November, so the earlier you request a quote, the more flexibility you get on install dates between early October and the first week of December. Waiting until late November often means a narrower window of available dates for your crew.

faq.q: What if I only want part of the program, like installation without storage?
faq.a: That is completely fine. Design, installation and mid-season maintenance are the core of the service, and takedown is always included, while year-round storage is genuinely optional and can be added or left off depending on your garage space. Let us know your preference when you request a quote, and we will price the program to match exactly what you want.
